skills.title: Decompose problems
objectives: Break a problem into smaller tasks with clear inputs and outputs.
Explain how solving the smaller tasks contributes to the original goal.

skills.title: Recognise patterns
objectives: Compare examples and identify repeated structures or rules.
Use a discovered pattern to describe how a new example may behave.

skills.title: Abstract relevant details
objectives: Separate information relevant to a stated goal from irrelevant detail.
Represent a problem using only the information needed to solve it.

skills.title: Design step-by-step algorithms
objectives: Write an ordered set of unambiguous steps that solves a defined problem.
Trace the steps against an example input and identify the expected output.
